scope: Retrospective conditional 32-station departure development comparison; no production activation
selection: Choose the lowest pooled June validation MAE within each estimator family and feature arm, persist before refit or September metrics, then identify the overall validation winner. Ties within 1e-9 prefer Poisson, histogram boosting, random forest; alpha 1.0; forest depth 10; lexical candidate ID.
evaluation: September is inspected development evidence. Use identical weather-covered keys for all candidates and retain release maturity and three-target boundary purges from the base protocol.

confirmation.status: pending source coverage and a separate pre-outcome freeze
confirmation.departure_label_note: Under the existing month-end plus 45-day assumption, November outcomes cannot be fully mature before January 2027; later supplying cohorts can delay them further.

limitations: September station outcomes were previously inspected
Restricted metadata-selected 32-station cohort with conditional operating-hour support
Trip publication and historical weather availability use declared reconstruction assumptions
Exact advisory ablation remains gated by missing rich April-June alert history
